No Marketing Talk.What makes Revalgo different from other automation tools?Most "AI" tools in distribution convert inbound documents - they read an email and turn it into an ERP entry. Revalgo does the work behind the document. We source non-stocks across your suppliers, confirm POs with vendors, qualify and respond to bids, and build orders end to end. Your team supervises exceptions instead of doing the work.Can I start with one product, or do I need the whole suite?Yes. Most distributors begin with one product, usually Sales Order Automation, where the time drain is sharpest. From there, the platform expands to Purchasing Automation, Bid Automation, and Content Automation as results come in. Run one or run them all - they get smarter together.How accurate is the automation?Sales Order Automation reads unstructured input - emails, faxes, handwritten orders - and accuracy improves as the system learns your products and customers. Purchasing Automation cuts manual invoice intervention from 40% or more down to under 10%. Bid Automation extracts thousands of line items in hours with accuracy that compounds across engagements. Every AI decision carries a confidence score, and you set the threshold for automatic processing versus human review.Will this work with my ERP?Yes. Revalgo is ERP-agnostic and integrates with the systems distributors actually use - including older ERPs without modern APIs. We have connected to systems other vendors said couldn't be integrated.How long does implementation take?Forward-deployed engineers work alongside your team to map workflows, edge cases, and sourcing rules before automation goes live. Revalgo owns the full onboarding process end to end - we don't hand you a configuration and walk away.How Is Our Data Protected?Every customer runs on a single-tenant deployment. Your orders, pricing, supplier terms and catalog train your instance only - never a shared model, and never a competitor's. Revalgo maintains SOC 2 Type 2 attestation, and your ERP stays the system of record throughout. Ready to see Revalgo in action?A 30-minute demo with a Revalgo team member who knows distribution.
